#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;
const long long INV2 = 499122177LL;

long long modPow(long long base, long long exp) {
    long long res = 1;
    base %= MOD;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) {
            res = (res * base) % MOD;
        }
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    long long n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;
    
    long long d = r - l + 1;
    long long nm = n * m;
    long long diff = d & 1LL;
    
    long long ans = (modPow(d, nm) + modPow(diff, nm)) % MOD;
    ans = ans * INV2 % MOD;
    if (nm % 2 == 1) {
        ans = modPow(d, nm);
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
